_status: DRAFT, NOT ACTIVATED. Planning document for slice 6 (WF-044). Not a contract: do not pass this file to `wf job new`. The coordinator builds the real contract.json from the `contract` object below after the owner's choices are filled in, with every <OWNER: ...> placeholder replaced.
_based_on: WF-022 rehearsal contract shape (wf022/zen c92340c, fixtures/results/wf022-zen/run_flow.py:89-102), FIRST-RELEASE-SPEC §12 candidate (b), ACCEPTANCE-LIST-DRAFT.md (from-zen/WF-022), updated for FIX1 (PR #56, dfd6e85).
_fix1_notes: I3: every wf call names the ledger explicitly: --db <boundary root>\ledger\wf.db (or WF_DB). There is no default ledger; without it wf exits 2 rejected(usage).

I1: the job id must match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}$ and must not end in '.' or a space, contain '..', be a Windows device name (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-9, LPT1-9, any case, any extension), or equal an existing job id case-insensitively.

I4: read_scope and write_scope below do not overlap (pristine/** vs scope/**), so `job new` returns no `warnings` key; if the owner changes either, a returned `warnings` entry is advisory, not a refusal, and should be resolved before activation.

Required contract keys at dfd6e85 (validate.CONTRACT_REQUIRED): owner_request, interpretation, baseline, outcome, acceptance_criteria, read_scope, write_scope, watch, presence_only, allowed_tools, limits, exclusions, evidence, closeout_rules, recovery_rules, observe_thresholds, environment. All are present below.
Do not run `wf observe` during the pilot until WF-042 item 2 (FIX2 #37) is fixed: its log path is outside the P4 coordination set.

_owner_must_choose.job_id: the pilot job id (see FIX1 I1 rules), e.g. pilot-docfix-1
_owner_must_choose.boundary_root: a disposable local folder outside every repository, AIEP and BIMpossible path, e.g. %LOCALAPPDATA%\wf-pilot\
_owner_must_choose.owner_request.quote: the owner's request in the owner's own words (verbatim)
_owner_must_choose.owner_request.source_turn: the reference of the owner turn that contains that quote
_owner_must_choose.acceptance_criteria: approve AC1-AC7 as drafted, or change them; especially AC6 (byte identity with pristine) vs a looser 'only the five lines changed'
_owner_must_choose.pristine_visibility: whether the builder may read pristine/ (if not: keep it out of the builder's binding paths; it is already excluded from write)
_owner_must_choose.observe_thresholds: slow_s / silent_s placeholders (spec §7: contract parameters, unmeasured)
_owner_must_choose.limits: the stated stance/posture line (P-SUPERVISED, E1) and any time limit

owner_request.quote: <OWNER: verbatim request, e.g. 'Repair the five documentation inconsistencies in the copied folder (job <job_id>)'>

contract.interpretation: restore each planted inconsistency I1-I5 in scope/** to its pristine text; change nothing else
contract.outcome: scope/** equals pristine/** byte for byte; AC1-AC7 pass

acceptance_criteria.check: wf accept changeset: only scope/** changed and undeclared is empty

contract.limits: <OWNER: e.g. 'pilot: disposable local copy only; stance P-SUPERVISED; posture E1; owner present for the live run'>
evidence: wf verify --checkpoint output with the owner-retained checkpoint
contract.closeout_rules: close after accept; intervention declaration with real minutes or unknown (T21)
contract.recovery_rules: owner-present manual recovery (spec 3B, 6.2): stop-confirmed by the owner, reconcile, recover decide, replacement bind at generation+1, ack-reconcile
